s: June 16, 2023 - I'd still buy LC no problem, but just beware that the guarantee is not your life time. Just checked their website - 5 years for enamel on steel. They say enamel on iron is for the lifetime of the original purchaser ( or whoever received it new as a gift) for manufacturing fault, not 'normal wear and tear'. ... Lodge has a lifetime warranty too and is good-ish about honoring it.
